theater: 洛東江白藤江口（慶尚北道）

battle.name: 白藤江之戰 (938年)
battle.theater: 洛東江白藤江口（慶尚北道）
battle.brief: 九三八年十一月，新羅以大將軍金燕休為總帥，與後高句麗王弓乙、後百濟王甄蕤及倭國援軍戰於洛東江白藤江。新羅以草馬疑兵夜襲敵營，再分兵三路，盡破敵之兩翼與中央，倭國君長與大將相繼戰死，斬首溺死者以萬計。卡面的亞述長矛不在此役之列，但矛與盾的刺擊兵傳統，正是江畔列陣的底色。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 白藤江之戰是九三八年朝鮮半島三角對峙的一次總決戰，參戰的政權不是兩個而是三個，加上外援共成四方角力。東方是新羅：國王興聖王坐鎮慶州，實際統兵的是大將軍金燕休與金稚磣。金燕休原是北方高句麗與高麗的末代君主之一，歸附新羅後被授將軍，長期掌理洛東江流域的邊軍，他的指揮系統以部曲為基本單位，兵員多來自慶州、尚州、熊津一帶的良家與公私奴，兵種以弓手為主，配少量騎兵與步卒。金稚磣是王族內的將領，與金燕休並列為出征的兩大主將。北方是後高句麗：君主弓乙親自領兵，部眾以來自平壤及北方諸郡的高句麗舊民與歸附者為主，善弓的射手與輕裝步兵是骨幹，戰術上偏向游擊與擾亂。南方是後百濟：君主甄蕤坐鎮，其麾下大將白山、蓮花生皆原為新羅叛將，是全軍最銳利的先鋒與衝鋒力量，沿海還有一支以船隻活動的水軍。東面的倭國（日本朝廷）派出的援軍以滯留日本的百濟系渡來人為骨幹，夾雜大和朝廷的兵馬，倭國君長自任統帥。整個戰局因此是新羅一國對後百濟、後高句麗、倭國聯軍，東、南、北三面同時受敵。
countriesEn: The Battle of Baekgang was a decisive engagement in the triangular confrontation of the Korean peninsula in 938; the participants were not two states but three, and with foreign aid they made a four-cornered contest. In the east stood Silla: King Gyeongseong sat at Gyeongju, but the army in the field was commanded by the great generals Kim Yun-hu and Kim Si-seok. Kim Yun-hu had himself been among the last rulers of the northern states of Later Goguryeo and Goryeo; after submitting to Silla he was made a general and long held command of the frontier army in the valley of the Naktong river. His command system was built on units of retainers, with men drawn from the landholding families and from the public and private slaves of Gyeongju, Sangju and Gungju, the mass of them archers, supported by a small number of cavalry and foot. Kim Si-seok, a prince of the royal house, was the second of the two chief commanders appointed for the campaign. In the north stood Later Goguryeo: the ruler Gung Ye led the army in person, and his troops were mainly old Goguryeo people and deserters from Pyongyang and the northern commanderies, with skilled archers and light infantry forming the core, their style leaning towards harassment and disruption. In the south stood Later Baekje: the ruler Gyeon Hwon held court, and under him the great generals Baek San and Yeon Hwasaeng, both defectors from Silla, were the sharpest spearhead of the whole army, while a force working from boats along the coast supported them. From the east the Japanese court sent an allied army whose backbone was the Baekje-descended immigrants resident in Japan, mixed with troops and horses of the Yamato court, and the Japanese ruler took command in person. The result was Silla facing a coalition of Later Baekje, Later Goguryeo and Japan at one and the same time, one state against enemies on three fronts.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物集中在新羅一方。興聖王是決策者：白藤江的出兵方案得自大將軍金燕休的建言，國王批准，並以朝廷名冊調集各道兵與糧秣，使邊軍得以集中於洛東江一線。金燕休本人是戰役的實際統帥，也是戰後新羅對北方作戰的權威；他出身北方王族，先後在後高句麗與高麗擔任君主，後率部眾歸附新羅，藉此保住兵權並取得將軍之位。他主張乘後百濟與後高句麗互相猜忌之際出兵，先取百濟以孤立弓乙，此策定了白藤江的大勝。金稚磣是副手，與金燕休分統兩翼方向的兵，戰時負責左翼的攻擊與其後的追擊。敵方方面，後高句麗王弓乙自將大軍南下，敗後北逃，於九四一年在半島南部被醉酒的民眾殺死，後高句麗自此退回北方；後百濟王甄蕤敗走後退守熊津與莫郭山一隅，疆域縮至數縣，最終在九四三年被新羅攻滅，傳聞中本人亦死於亂軍之中。倭國方面，傳為甄氏宗女、流居日本並為日本朝廷效力的周留，據說促成此次出兵；戰中倭國君長與大將相繼戰死，其姓名在兩國史料中均未詳載。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of this war are concentrated on the Silla side. King Gyeongseong was the authorising authority: the plan for the campaign at Baekgang came from the proposal of the great general Kim Yun-hu, the king approved it, and the court registers were used to assemble troops and provisions from the circuits so that the frontier army could concentrate on the Naktong line. Kim Yun-hu was the actual commander in the field and afterwards the authority of Silla in the north. He was born into a northern royal house, was ruler in turn of Later Goguryeo and Goryeo, and after bringing his followers over to Silla kept his armed following and obtained the rank of general. It was his plan to strike while Later Baekje and Later Goguryeo still mistrusted each other, to deal with Baekje first and thereby isolate Gung Ye; that strategy produced the great victory at Baekgang. Kim Si-seok was his second, commanding one of the wings and the pursuit that followed. On the enemy side, Gung Ye led the northern army south in person and after the defeat withdrew north, to be killed in 941 by a drunken commoner in the southern part of the peninsula, after which Later Goguryeo fell back beyond the north. Gyeon Hwon of Later Baekje fell back to the district of Gungju and Mount Mogeum, reduced his state to a few counties, and was finally destroyed by Silla in 943, with the account that he himself perished in the disorder. On the Japanese side, the traditional record names Zhou Liu, a member of the Jeon house who had taken refuge in Japan and served the Japanese court, as the one who brought about the expedition; in the battle the Japanese ruler and the Japanese general were killed one after the other, and neither name is given in the sources of either country.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是公元前九百年前後兩河流域的兵器：短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃，亞述人把它與弓、斧綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。它與九三八年的白藤江沒有任何直接關係——亞述的短柄刺擊兵從未到過朝鮮半島，兩者相隔一千八百多年。把它放進這場戰爭，是因為它標示出刺擊兵在古代戰場上的功能位置：亞述矛兵習慣與小圓盾結合成密排的矛牆，攻城時頂著箭雨推鋒，野戰中則替弓手與斧兵守住正面。朝鮮半島在同一功能位置上使用的是另一套東西：木柄長矛與更長的槊，握在密排的步兵手中，盾則是皮面小圓盾與長身大盾。真正投入白藤江交戰的裝備大致可分三類。第一是弓：新羅弓兵數量最多，以桑木、楮木等製弓，矢鏃兼用鐵、骨、石；後高句麗以強弓著稱，倭國援軍也大量攜帶弓與短矢。第二是刀：兩軍步兵普遍佩短刀，後百濟與倭國的近戰主力是長刀，戰敗之時倭國君長正是以劍自刺而死。第三是馬：倭國聯軍有騎兵，後高句麗與新羅亦各有數百匹戰馬，但新羅的騎兵始終不成主力。輔助裝備包括盾、鐵鏃、革帶，以及後百濟的船隻——白藤江之戰的倭軍正是渡海而來，其糧秣依賴這條漫長而脆弱的海上補給線。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a weapon of the Mesopotamian world of about 900 BC: a short shaft, a long blade and an iron point, which the Assyrians tied together with bows and axes as city after city fell in the river lands. It has no direct connection with Baekgang in 938; Assyrian short-hafted stabbing weapons never reached the Korean peninsula, and the two lie more than eighteen hundred years apart. It is put into this war because it marks the functional place of the stabbing soldier on an ancient battlefield. The Assyrian spearmen habitually closed up with small round shields into a dense wall of spears, pushed forward under a rain of arrows when storming a city, and held the front for the archers and the axe-men in open battle. The peninsula's equivalent function was filled by something else: wooden-shafted spears and the longer so, carried in the hands of densely packed infantry, with hide-faced small round shields and long body shields for protection. The equipment actually brought into the fighting at Baekgang falls into three groups. First the bows: Silla had the largest number of archers, with bows of mulberry and paper mulberry wood and arrowheads of iron, bone and stone; Later Goguryeo was famous for its powerful bows, and the Japanese auxiliaries carried many bows and short arrows as well. Second the knives: infantry on both sides carried short knives, while the close combat core of Later Baekje and of the Japanese contingent used long swords, and it was with a sword that the Japanese ruler put an end to himself when the battle was lost. Third the horses: the Japanese-led coalition had cavalry, and both Later Goguryeo and Silla had a few hundred warhorses, but Silla's cavalry was never the main force. Support equipment included shields, iron arrowheads, leather belts, and the boats of Later Baekje, for the Japanese army had come by sea and its food and drink depended on that long and fragile maritime line of supply.
tactics: 白藤江的打法是典型的奇襲加分割。新羅的部署分兩步：九三七年先把主力壓到洛東江下游，攻取開城、漢山等後百濟要地，切斷其與倭國之間的陸路聯繫，再於九三八年集中兵力於江畔待機。決戰之日，金燕休沒有正面強攻。他先令人製作草馬——以枝條與薴麻紮成馬形、外披布帛——在夜間驅行於道上，揚起大片塵土，並輔以車載草梗，使遠處的敵營以為新羅大軍正從側面迫近。敵軍調兵回應的一刻，新羅全軍發起夜襲，並分成三路：一路正面糾纏敵軍中央，一路直取左右兩翼，一路迂迴到敵營背後縱火、亂其行列。倭國與後百濟的聯軍在黑暗中失去統一指揮，各自為戰，兩翼先行崩潰，潰兵衝垮本已吃緊的中軍。混戰之中倭國君長與大將相繼戰死，聯軍大部或被斬或溺水於江中，殘部北散。新羅乘勝追擊至熊津方向，後百濟僅以莫郭山一隅自保。就整體戰役而言，這是一次以補給線與士氣取勝的會戰：新羅集中了洛東江防線與沿海水軍的優勢，敵方則因後百濟與後高句麗各有私心，加上渡海遠來的倭軍缺乏縱深與統一號令，兵力雖多而無法同時發揮。
tacticsEn: The method at Baekgang was a typical combination of surprise attack and fragmentation. Silla's deployment had two stages. In 937 it first pushed the main body down to the lower Naktong, taking the Later Baekje strongholds of Kaesong and Hansan and cutting the land link between that state and Japan; in 938 it then concentrated its forces on the riverbank and waited. On the day of the battle Kim Yun-hu did not attack frontally. He first had straw horses made, branches and ramie bound into the shape of horses and covered with cloth, driven along the road by night so that they raised great clouds of dust, with carts of stalks added so that the enemy camp would believe a great Silla army was closing in from the flank. At the moment when the enemy redeployed in answer, the whole Silla army launched a night attack in three columns: one to engage the enemy centre frontally, one to strike the left and right wings, and one to swing round behind the camp, setting fires and breaking up the ranks. In the darkness the Japanese and Later Baekje coalition lost unified command and fought as separate bodies; the wings gave way first, and the fugitives from them broke the hard-pressed centre. In the melee the Japanese ruler and the Japanese general were killed one after the other, much of the coalition was killed or drowned in the river, and the survivors scattered north. Silla pursued them as far as the direction of Gungju, and Later Baekje could hold nothing but the neighbourhood of Mount Mogeum. Taken as a whole, the engagement was a battle won by supply lines and morale: Silla concentrated the advantages of the Naktong defence line and of its coastal fleet, while the enemy, with Later Baekje and Later Goguryeo each nursing separate interests, and with a Japanese army freshly arrived by sea that had neither depth nor a single voice, could not bring its numerical superiority to bear.
data: 可據以寫的數字大致如下。時間：決戰在九三八年十一月，通行說法記為陰曆十一月二十七日；新羅的準備則自九三七年攻取開城、漢山時已開始，前後約一年。兵力：《三國史記》系記錄所傳的數字為新羅軍約一萬五千，後高句麗、後百濟與倭國聯軍約五萬，也有聯軍更多之說；這些數字出自戰後追述而非同時代編年，學界多視為概數，較可靠的判斷是新羅軍的規模遠小於敵軍總量。地點與距離：白藤江的主流考證指慶尚北道龜尾、慶山郡一帶的洛東江下游，決戰地距新羅首都慶州約一百一十公里，熊津（今全羅南道谷城郡一帶）距此約一百四十公里；白藤江一線在九三〇年已被新羅築成約三百里的長城防線，是雙方反覆爭奪的關鍵工事。戰果：《三國史記》記斬首一萬餘級、溺死者亦如之、俘虜略盡，並記倭國君長與大將戰死；新羅自身的損失記錄簡略，未見確數。此後的時間點也可作為戰果的旁證：後百濟在九三六年一度覆亡，經白藤江一敗只剩熊津與莫郭山一隅，九四三年被新羅攻滅；弓乙於九四一年被殺，後高句麗退回北方；九三〇年所築的白江長城則在統一之後失去意義。
dataEn: The figures that can be given are roughly as follows. Time: the decisive battle was fought in the eleventh month of 938, which is commonly given as the twenty-seventh day of the lunar eleventh month; Silla's preparations had begun with the taking of Kaesong and Hansan in 937, roughly a year earlier. Strength: the figure transmitted in the records of the Samguk Sagi is about fifteen thousand men for the Silla army against about fifty thousand for the coalition of Later Goguryeo, Later Baekje and Japan, and there are also accounts of a still larger enemy force; these numbers come from a post-war narrative rather than from a contemporary chronicle, and historians generally treat them as rough estimates, the more reliable conclusion being that Silla's army was far smaller than the enemy total. Place and distance: the prevailing identification of Baekgang points to the lower Naktong in the districts of Gumi and Gyeongsan in northern Gyeongsang, about a hundred and ten kilometres from the Silla capital of Gyeongju, and about a hundred and forty kilometres from Gungju, in what is now Gokseong county in southern Jeolla. The Baekgang line had already been fortified by Silla in 930 with a rampart of some three hundred li, and it was the key work that the two sides fought over again and again. Results: the Samguk Sagi records that over ten thousand were beheaded, as many again were drowned, and that almost all the prisoners were taken, and that the Japanese ruler and the Japanese general were killed; Silla's own losses are recorded only in general terms and no certain figure survives. Later dates serve as indirect evidence of the result: Later Baekje, already destroyed once in 936, was reduced after Baekgang to the district of Gungju and Mount Mogeum and was ended by Silla in 943; Gung Ye was killed in 941 and Later Goguryeo withdrew north; and the rampart built at Baekgang in 930 lost its purpose once the peninsula was united.
cause: 打起來的原因是一連串彼此嵌套的問題，遠早於九三八年。第一層是舊秩序的復辟：後百濟在九〇〇年由甄蕤重建，九〇一年弓乙在北方建後高句麗並於九一八年稱帝，兩股前王朝的殘餘勢力在統一的新羅面前站住了腳，統一事業因此倒退。第二層是實實在在的邊界戰爭：九二七年甄蕤大舉攻入新羅，一度攻陷慶州，玄界一帶的民眾被擄往南方；九三一年新羅收復失地，九三六年再滅後百濟，把南疆分割給數家豪族，但甄蕤很快復出，九三七年新羅攻破開城與漢山，甄蕤退守熊津。第三層是倭國的介入：滯留日本的百濟系渡來人一直保有自己的武裝與政權傳統，甄氏在走投無路時向大和朝廷求援，日本於是以渡海遠征的形式出兵，這支部隊的船隊與糧秣都要橫渡海峽，作戰縱深極短。第四層是新羅自身的需要：興聖王即位後整頓道制、推行品秩、抑制地方豪族並加強海防，這些措施需要一場對外勝利來取得正當性，而弓乙與甄蕤互相不能信任，正是可以利用的破綻。最終作戰計劃由金燕休提出，時機選在後百濟與後高句麗尚未完全合流、倭國援軍剛到、海上補給線最脆弱的時候。
causeEn: The reasons go back a long way and are nested one inside another, well before 938. The first layer is the restoration of the old order: Later Baekje was refounded by Gyeon Hwon in 900, and Gung Ye established Later Goguryeo in the north in 901 and proclaimed himself emperor in 918; two remnants of the former dynasties kept their footing in the face of the unifying Silla, and the work of unification was thrown back. The second layer is a real border war. In 927 Gyeon Hwon carried a great war into Silla and for a time took Gyeongju, and the people of the Hyonggye region were carried off to the south; Silla recovered the ground in 931 and destroyed Later Baekje once more in 936, dividing the southern border among several powerful families, but Gyeon Hwon soon came back, and in 937 Silla broke through Kaesong and Hansan and drove him back to Gungju. The third layer is Japanese intervention: the Baekje-descended immigrants resident in Japan had always kept their own armed organisation and political tradition, and in their extremity the Jeon house appealed to the Yamato court, which sent an army across the sea; that army's shipping and provisions had to cross the strait, and its depth of operations was extremely short. The fourth layer is what Silla itself needed: after his accession Gyeongseong reorganised the circuits, carried through the rank system, restrained the local great families and strengthened the coastal defence, and all of this required a foreign victory to gain legitimacy, while the mutual distrust between Gung Ye and Gyeon Hwon was a gap that could be used. The final plan was proposed by Kim Yun-hu, and the moment was chosen when the two enemy states had not yet fully joined hands, the Japanese reinforcements had just arrived, and the maritime line of supply was at its most fragile.
impact: 白藤江一戰的影響，首先是直接改寫了朝鮮半島的權力地圖。後百濟被壓到莫郭山與熊津一隅，兩年後亡國；後高句麗失去南進的根據地，退回北方，統一的主動權回到新羅手中。以往三國分立、後百濟與後高句麗聯手抗線的局面告一段落，新羅由此確立後三國統一的官方目標，六品與十道的整頓、兵將分離與郡縣編制、海軍與長城防線的維持，都沿著這一方向推進。對北方而言，這是一個警號：高句麗舊地的人心思歸，後高句麗退回鴨綠江以北，而渤海系在東北的衰落，也讓半島得以集中力量對付北方，這是統一得以在十世紀末完成的前提。對日本而言，代價同樣具體：援助後百濟的渡來百濟人勢力遭受重創，倭國的君長與大將戰死，而日本與新羅的直接往來自此中斷，直到十二世紀才重新恢復；在此之前，倭國在日本列島的內部競爭中只能退守，承平天慶之亂前後的亂局因此更難收拾。長期看，這場戰爭還改變了高句麗系的走向：金燕休以高句麗王族的身份在白藤江立下大功，新羅朝廷對高句麗系的倚重與提攜大幅增加，三十餘年後新羅亡國、高句麗重建時，主導者正是同一族系。
impactEn: The effect of the battle at Baekgang was first of all to redraw the political map of the peninsula. Later Baekje was squeezed back to Mount Mogeum and Gungju and was extinguished two years later; Later Goguryeo lost its base for a southern advance and withdrew north, and the initiative in unification returned to Silla. The old pattern of three states in stalemate, with Later Baekje and Later Goguryeo holding the line together, came to an end, and Silla established as its official aim the unification of the three later kingdoms; the reorganisation into the six ranks and the ten circuits, the separation of soldiers from administrators, the county system, the maintenance of the fleet and the frontier lines all advanced in that direction. For the north the outcome was a warning: the hearts of the people of the old Goguryeo lands turned back towards the south, Later Goguryeo withdrew beyond the Yalu, and the decline of the Balhae interest in the north-east allowed the peninsula to concentrate its strength against the northerners, which was the precondition for the completion of unification at the end of the tenth century. The cost was equally concrete for Japan: the power of the Baekje-descended immigrants in Japan that had backed Later Baekje was badly hurt, the Japanese ruler and general were killed, and direct contact between Japan and Silla was cut, not to be resumed until the twelfth century. In the years before and after the Johei and Tenkei disturbances, the Japanese court could only hold what it had. In the long run the war also changed the course of the Goguryeo-descended families: Kim Yun-hu, a member of the northern royal house, won his great fame at Baekgang, the Silla court came to rely on and promote such families far more than before, and thirty years later, when Silla fell and Goryeo was refounded, the men who led it came from that same line.
result: 結果是新羅的完勝，而且是代價極小、收益極大的一種完勝。白藤江江畔，新羅聯軍以草馬疑兵與夜襲打亂了數倍於己的敵軍，斬首一萬餘級、溺死者亦如之、俘虜略盡；倭國君長與大將相繼戰死，倭國援軍幾乎全滅，殘兵渡海散去；後百濟名將白山的部隊被衝垮，甄蕤僅以數十騎逃回熊津莫郭山；弓乙放棄戰鬥，退回北方。戰後，新羅乘勢掃清洛東江下游與漢山一帶的地盤，九四三年終於攻下熊津、滅亡後百濟，把朝鮮半島南部與中部重新置於一個政權之下，為九四五年新羅與後高句麗先後內亂後的統一鋪平了道路。戰役的戰術意義同樣被後世反覆引用：以疑兵與夜襲製造局部優勢、以分進合擊瓦解優勢兵力，是弱軍如何取勝的經典範本，而其中扮演關鍵角色的，是把北方亡國之眾編入新軍的金燕休。這場勝利的代價則落在別處：白藤江之後不到兩年，新羅境內便接連出現地方叛兵與朝廷內部的權力角力，加上弓乙在北方捲土重來，新羅並未立刻獲得它所追求的安定；真正把統一成果坐實的，還要等景德王與忠聖王時代的整頓，以及新羅自身在十世紀末的衰落與高句麗的重建。
resultEn: The result was a complete Silla victory, and a complete victory bought at a very small price. On the banks of the Naktong the Silla forces used straw-horse feints and a night attack to break an enemy several times their number; over ten thousand were beheaded, as many again drowned, and nearly all the prisoners were taken; the Japanese ruler and the Japanese general were killed in the fighting, and the Japanese auxiliaries were almost annihilated, the survivors scattering back across the sea. The command of the Later Baekje general Baek San was broken up, and Gyeon Hwon escaped with a few riders to Gungju and Mount Mogeum; Gung Ye gave up the battle and withdrew north. Afterwards Silla swept the lower Naktong and the country around Hansan, and in 943 finally captured Gungju and ended Later Baekje, bringing the southern and central parts of the peninsula once more under a single government and preparing the way for the unification that followed the internal collapse of Silla and Later Goguryeo in 945. The tactical meaning of the battle has been quoted again and again since: how a weaker army can win by feint and night attack and by dividing the enemy so that its numbers cannot be brought to bear. The man who made it work was Kim Yun-hu, who folded the men of a fallen northern state into a new Silla army. The cost was paid elsewhere. Within two years of Baekgang, local insurgents and struggles for power inside the Silla court came to the surface, and Gung Ye began to recover in the north, so that the peace Silla had sought did not follow at once. The unification achieved in 938 was made good only later, by the reforms of Kings Gyeongdeok and Chungryong and by the very decline of Silla at the end of the tenth century and the refounding of Goryeo.
